out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no sign at the handwashing sink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The EHS provided a sign for the sink during the inspection.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. A container of soap was stored on the three compartment sink drying board.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The PIC moved the soap during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: during the inspection, a food employee touched the shredded cheese mix in the prep unit with his bare hand to check if it was cold.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. The EHS discussed this with the PIC. The cheese was discarded.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no “employees must wash hands” sign at the hand sink next to the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days. EL TIO TEX-MEX GRILL (Inspection Date: 03/31/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: some foods in the 2-door prep top refrigerator were not being held at the proper cold holding temperature in the top portion of the unit. Birria beef was 44º, raw salmon was 56º, and sliced tomatoes were 46º. Foods in the bottom portion was clams 42º, raw shrimp 41º, cream sauce 42º, mango habanero sauce 42º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The sliced tomatoes, birria beef, raw salmon were discarded. CDI.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the bottom of the back door. There is a large gap at the bottom of the back door.
violations.corrective_action: The sweep at the bottom of the door is missing. Replaced the missing sweep as soon as possible to prevent pests from entering the establishment from the outside. When correctly repaired, there shoudl be no outside light visible inside when the door is fully closed.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the ambient temperature of the 2-door prep top unit was 41º and some foods in it were out of temperature and had to be discarded.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Please have the unit serviced to ensure it is working properly. Correct as soon as possible of within 10 days and notify your EHS when it has been serviced.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed a significant amount of dust and debris on the HVAC ceiling diffusers and light shields over the main prep line in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the HVAC diffusers and light shields to remove the dust and debris and keep it from getting in foods. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw steak stored above cooked pork ribs in walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC was informed by handouts about policy on storage raw and RTE food products. PIC placed cooked pork ribs above raw steak.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Internal condensate shelf of ice machine is not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC removed ice from machine and washed, rinsed, and sanitized all internal surfaces.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked white rice at 123F (from yesterday), cooked chicken at 123 (1hr) in hot holding cabinet.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC discarded cooked white rice. PIC reheated cooked chicken to 165F and placed in the steam well at a temperature of 135F and above.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed hot holding cabinet at 126F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC discontinued use of hot holding cabinet until repairs will be completed. PIC contacted a technician during the inspection. PIC will email a technician’s invoice to EHS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the 3 vat sink being used for storage of colander.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CFM removed items.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shrimp over RTE lettuce.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM rearranged items.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked Birria from 2 days ago , 2 containers of ribs from 2 days ago, container of tamales from 2 days ago.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. All items date marked.
